coordinateSystem: ISO 8855: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up, origin at rear-axle ground projection (Z=0)
originDefinition: Ground projection of center of rear axle (Z=0)
assumptions: Origin placed at ground projection of rear axle center per ISO 8855 standard
Forward direction is +X, lateral driver-left direction is +Y, upward vertical direction is +Z
Driver nominal seating position placed inside cabin (X = +1.30m, Y = +0.38m, Z = +1.20m)
A-pillar 8-vertex prism base at X = 2.10m, top at X = 1.50m (sloping rearward as it ascends)
Representative parameters for algorithm validation only, not calibrated against any production vehicle
